meal.title: Define Global Constants for Settings
meal.objective: Define configuration values in all caps at the top of the file

voice.script: What if you could change the game rules without touching the code? How do you store settings that stay the same everywhere? Global constants are values written in all caps at the top of the file. They act like permanent settings your program can read anywhere. Now we define three constants: MAX_LINES, MIN_BET, and MAX_BET. MAX_LINES tells how many lines the slot machine can play at once. MIN_BET is the smallest amount you may wager on a single line. MAX_BET caps the highest wager per line. Running the program prints the constants so you see they are ready to use. Remember: put unchanging configuration values in all caps at the top.
